privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.summary_device: Duk bayanan al'adarka suna kasancewa a na'urarka: babu asusu, babu sabar.
privacy.summary_no_sell: Ba mu taɓa tattara, sayar da, ko raba bayananka na sirri ba.
privacy.summary_sync: Duk kwafin ajiyar da ka yi ana yin encryption da shi kafin ya bar na'urarka: ba za mu iya karanta shi ba.
privacy.summary_delete: Goge bayananka a Saituna, ko share app ɗin, domin goge komai har abada.
privacy.local_first: Luna app ne da ke aiki a cikin na'ura da farko (local-first). Ana adana bayanan sirri a na'urarka kaɗai: a cikin rumbun ajiya na gida mai encryption (SQLCipher) a iOS da Android, da kuma a cikin ma'ajiyar burauza mai encryption a yanar gizo (AES-256-GCM). Babu asusu, kuma Macaron Software ba shi da wani sani game da bayananka.
privacy.no_trackers: Ba a amfani da cookies, analytics, tallace-tallace, ko masu bin diddigin ɓangare na uku ba.

terms.title: Sharuɗɗan Sabis
terms.point_tool: Luna kayan aiki ne na sirri don bin diddigin al'ada: ba rigakafin ciki ba ne, ba kuma shawara ta likita ba.
terms.point_data: Bayananka naka ne; ba mu da hanyar samun su.
terms.point_free: Kyauta don amfani; ba a buƙatar biyan kuɗi na wata-wata ba.
terms.point_open_source: Buɗaɗɗen tushe (open source) ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT da Apache-2.0.
terms.body_no_advice: Luna ba ya bayar da shawara ta likita, ganewar asali, ko magani, kuma ba hanya ce ta rigakafin ciki ba. Koyaushe tuntuɓi ƙwararren likita game da matsalolin lafiya.
terms.body_as_is: Ana bayar da app ɗin yadda yake, ba tare da wani garanti ba. Hasashen al'ada da kiyasin lokacin haihuwa na iya zama marasa daidai; Macaron Software ba shi da alhakin shawarwarin da aka yanke bisa bayanan da aka rubuta a cikin app ɗin.
